description: Heritage `value of … for key` on a MISSING dict key raises the byte-identical Core `ol-unknown-key` (issue #670, slice H5): same `code`, `params` (`{ key: "zed" }`), `stage: "runtime"` and `severity` -- the four fields this fixture actually compares, since it does not set `compareMessages` and so asserts no prose (issue #1025) -- as a Core `:ages["zed"]` selector would raise (`spec/data-structures.md:231`), with NO Heritage spelling in any payload — proving the reader lowers onto the Core dict read, not a divergent path (`spec/conformance.md:146`: alternate spellings only, no new semantics). The diagnostic *span* points at the reader's `for key "zed"` sub-expression, the reader's analog of the `["zed"]` span the selector points at (a where-the-learner-wrote-it, localization-only difference — `spec/localization.md`). Heritage depends on Data (`spec/conformance.md:301`), so both `data` and `heritage` are active.
